name: pulse-documentation-dx
description: Documents reusable React components in this Laravel app. Use when a component API, behaviour, accessibility model, variants, integration pattern, or limitation should be explained for future developers or AI agents.
purpose: Make component APIs and behaviour understandable for future maintainers and AI agents.
single_responsibility: Document the public API, behaviour, and limitations of reusable React components for future maintainers and AI agents.
triggers: A reusable component is created or significantly changed
Public API, variants, controlled/uncontrolled behaviour, accessibility, or integration details need explanation
completion_criteria: Documentation target is chosen (inline, existing doc, or none) without creating new files unless requested
Public API, variants, callbacks, and defaults are explained with minimal realistic examples
Accessibility, keyboard, responsive, motion, and integration behaviour is noted where relevant
Known limitations and source-of-truth notes are recorded
validation_criteria: No stale duplicate docs were added
failure_handling: If documentation would require a new file the user did not request, stop and ask instead of creating scattered docs.
Report any behaviour that could not be documented because the public API or source of truth was unclear.
escalation_path: Route uncertain Inertia, React, Radix, Motion, Tailwind, or Testing Library behaviour through pulse-docs-research.
Escalate to the user when a new documentation file or location is needed.
responsibilities: Explain props, variants, callbacks, and defaults.
Note accessibility, keyboard, responsive, and motion behaviour.
Note Inertia, Radix, form, or route integration.
Record source-sensitive usage notes when behaviour depends on Inertia, React, Radix, Motion, Tailwind, or Testing Library APIs.
non_responsibilities: Creating new documentation files without an explicit user request.
